sloka: अद्य मद्बाणभिन्नस्य गतासोः पतितस्य ते ।कर्षन्त्वन्त्राणि पतगा गरुत्मन्त इवोरगान् ।। ६.१०५.२२ ।।
transliteration: adya madbāṇabhinnasya gatāsoḥ patitasya te ।karṣantvantrāṇi patagā garutmanta ivoragān ।। 6.105.22 ।।

translations.english: "Let the birds tear your intestines as eagles would tear off snakes, now when your body is split and fallen, split by my arrows and ceased of life."
